_readme: One entry per risk tier. babysit-pr passes the tier's entry to workflows/review-round.js as args.tier. model and effort: every agent that judges or changes code for a tier runs on the tier's model at the tier's effort: its reviewers, the skeptics of its major findings, the fixer, and for a spec forecast at that tier build-feature's builder and spec-feature's skeptic. The tiers are one ladder (Anthropic's model guidance): raise effort before the model, never past high, and start the next model up at a lower effort; nothing runs at xhigh or max, where a level costs as much as a bigger model. secondModel adds a second adversary, and the second skeptic of a blocker, on the next model up. skepticModel checks minor findings. Round 1 is a full round: portionLenses run once per part of the change, wholeLenses once over all of it (it also runs again in full after the tier rose or someone else pushed). A follow-up round reviews only the commits since the last round, with followUpLenses. skeptics = every finding is checked by a skeptic before it is posted: major and blocker findings in batches on the tier's model, minor ones in batches on skepticModel, and a blocker by a second skeptic on secondModel. severityBar = the lowest severity that makes a full round unclean; a follow-up round is unclean only on a major or blocker finding. The review is done after a clean round, or when nothing changed since an unclean one; an unclean round is followed by a follow-up round, up to maxRounds. Lens names are defined in workflows/review-round.js.
